body:
# Baby Potion
Baby Potion adds a new "Potion of Infantilism" brewed with the Golden Dandelion and an Awkward Potion. The potion temporarily reverts mobs to their baby form (or scales them down if no baby form exists). This mod requires both server and client to install the mod.

![Mobs without native baby models affected by potion of infantilism making them appear baby size and chibi](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/194c2e6979a5d9fc921c5c38c9d4cfb577bce73a_0.webp)

## Features
- **Potion of Infantilism:** Brewed with Awkward Potion + Golden Dandelion.
- **Effect:** Reverts mobs to baby form for 3 minutes.
- **No effect:** If mob is already a baby, or is a mob that doesn't really make sense to have a baby version (primarily constucts of some sort)
- **Game Rule:** `Custom Babies' Scaling` game rule is used to control whether or not to include mobs that don't natively have a baby form. Also can be set to `Chibi` mode where it tweaks the models to try and match the style of the native babies.
